transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… I just don’t care about much anymore. Things I used to do—art classes, game nights, hiking, soccer—I just don’t go. I mostly sit in my room and let everything kind of fall apart.
Do you ever hear voices that other people can’t hear?
Yeah… sometimes. It’s a woman’s voice, usually from the corner of my room. It says I ruined everything and that I should stay inside. It sounds… really clear, like she’s right next to my bed.
Do you hear that woman’s voice only when you’re feeling very down?

No… not only then. There was a time before I got really low where I was still kind of functioning—cooking sometimes, answering friends. But I was already hearing her for weeks… and thinking the hallway lights were, like, signals about me.
Was there ever a time when you were hearing the voice even though you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. Before I got really bad, I could still cook sometimes and answer friends, but I was already hearing her… and I thought the hallway lights were signals about me. That went on for weeks.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy?
Not really… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times I couldn’t sleep much, but not like… happy or full of energy.
For at least two weeks, have you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like… there isn’t really anything past these apartment walls.
For at least one month, were you hearing the woman’s voice or thinking the hallway lights were signals about you?
Yes… definitely more than a month. It started a few months after my divorce, and it’s been… almost two years now. Like a year and eight months, I think.
During the time since the voice and the hallway-light ideas began, have you been depressed for most of that time?

Yeah… I think so. Most of it, honestly. It hasn’t just been the fear or the… confusion. I’ve been really down most of the time. Like I don’t care about much anymore, and it feels like my life is already over.
Was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when you were hearing the voice or thinking the lights were sending you messages, but you were not depressed?

Yeah… I think there was. Before it got really bad, there were a few weeks where I wasn’t… as depressed. I could still cook sometimes, answer friends.

But I was already hearing her, and I thought the hallway lights were… about me. Like signals.
Since the voice and the hallway-light beliefs first began, have you been depressed for more than half of that time?
Yeah… more than half. Most of the time since all this started, I’ve been really depressed. Not just scared or mixed up… just kind of empty, like nothing matters anymore.
